column1: # Reviewed ForeverDB.net observations accepted into the LootJinx catalog.
# Every row was checked by hand against tools/foreverdb_loot.tsv. Only items that
# ForeverDB.net attributes to exactly one boss are accepted; world drops, quest
# items, trade goods, keys, lockboxes and greens seen on several bosses are not.
# Existing ForeverDungeonJournal sources always win: a row that contradicts them
# is reported as a conflict and never overwrites the catalog.
# Format: dungeon<TAB>boss<TAB>itemID<TAB>item name<TAB>observed drops<TAB>observed kills<TAB>page URL
